How an OpenScript diagnostic is laid out in the /trading editor (its code, severity, message, cause and fix), when each kind is found, and the eight code ranges that say what kind of problem it is.

t: The stage: when a problem is found
Working through a list of diagnostics

d: Every OS1 code, raised when the text of a script cannot be read as a program, from characters the language does not use to indentation, brackets and statements written in the wrong shape.
Unexpected character {char}. {suggestion}
{written} is not a colour: a colour literal is # and six or eight hexadecimal digits.

t: OS1029 A name written against a number
d: {written} is neither a number nor a name: the number literal ends at {number}, and a name cannot begin with a digit.
This string literal opens with {quote} and the line ends before a matching {quote}.
{sequence} is not an escape sequence.
{marker} does not open or close a comment. A comment is written // and runs to the end of its line.
; is not part of the language.
This line is indented with a tab.

t: OS1003 Indentation does not match this block
d: This line is indented {found} spaces; the block opened at line {line} is indented {expected}.

t: OS1028 A continuation line is not indented past its statement
d: A continuation line must be indented more deeply than the line its statement began on; line {line} is indented {statement} and this line is indented {found}.

t: OS1010 Block header with no body
d: {header} opens a block, and the next line is not indented more deeply.

t: OS1016 else does not follow an if
d: This else is indented {found} spaces and the nearest if is indented {expected}.
The {bracket} opened at line {line} is never closed.
Found {found} where {expected} was expected, closing the {opener} opened at line {line}.
Two arguments run together; a comma is missing before {token}.
An expression was expected after {token}.

t: OS1015 Ternary with no second arm
d: This ? has no matching:
A comparison cannot be chained: {op1} is already applied before {op2}.

t: OS1018 More than one statement on a line
d: Unexpected {token} after the end of this statement.

t: OS1006 Assignment used as a condition
d: = assigns a value, and a condition needs a comparison.

t: OS1009 break or continue outside a loop
d: {word} is only valid inside a for or a while body.

t: OS1011 var with no initial value
d: var {name} has no initial value.

t: OS1017 case or default in the wrong place
d: {word} is only valid inside a switch, and default must be its last arm.

t: OS1019 Reserved word used as a name
d: {word} is a reserved word and cannot be used as a name.
A for header needs = start to end or in array; found {token}.

t: OS1021 The version declaration is not first
d: version must be the first line that is not blank and not a comment; line {line} came before it.

t: OS1023 A function declared inside a block
d: fn {name} is declared inside a block, and a function is declared at the top level of the file.

t: OS1024 Assignment to an indexed element
d: An assignment writes to a name, and this target is an index into {name}.
An assignment writes to a name, and this target is the member {member} of {name}.
Every OS2 code, raised when a script parses but its meaning does not work out, such as a name read before it exists, a name declared twice, or two values of types that do not fit together.

t: A script that gets names and types right
OS2001 Name is not defined here
d: {name} is not defined at this point in the file.

t: OS2002 The name already exists in an enclosing scope
d: {name} is already declared at line {line}, so a second one cannot be declared here.

t: OS2006 Assignment to a loop variable
d: {name} is this loop's variable and cannot be assigned inside the body.

t: OS2009 Unknown member of a namespace
d: {namespace} has no member named {member}.

t: OS2010 This name is not a function
d: {name} is {type}, not a function, so it cannot be called.

t: OS2020 Name is planned, not implemented
d: {name} is planned and is not implemented in this version.
{leftType} and {rightType} do not mix here.

t: OS2011 A condition must be a bool
d: This condition is {type}; a condition must be bool or none.

t: OS2012 The two arms of the ternary have different types
d: The arms of this ?: are {leftType} and {rightType}.

t: OS2013 An array literal mixes types
d: This array holds {firstType} at index 0 and {otherType} at index {index}.

t: OS2004 This value has no history
d: {expr} has no history, so [] cannot read a past value of it.

t: OS2015 The element type of this empty array is unknown
d: An empty array literal needs its element type from an annotation or from a first use.

t: OS2016 Unknown type in an annotation
d: {type} is not a type.

t: OS2019 This type cannot be an array element
d: array<{type}> is not a type: {type} cannot be an array element.
{name} calls itself: {cycle}.

t: OS2014 A function cannot be used as a value
d: {name} is a function, and version 1 has no function values.

t: OS2017 A function with this name is already declared
d: {name} is already declared as a function at line {line}.
{name} appears twice in this parameter list.

t: OS2007 The file has no declaration
d: A file needs one study() or strategy() declaration before any other statement.
This file already declares {kind} at line {line}.

Every OS3 code, raised when a call is written wrongly where it stands, such as the wrong arguments, a value the parameter does not accept, a per-bar value where a fixed one belongs, or a call that must sit at the top level.

t: A script whose calls are all well formed

d: {name} takes {expected} arguments and {found} were given.
{name} has no argument called {argument}.

t: OS3005 Positional argument after a named one
d: A positional argument cannot follow a named one.
{argument} is given twice at this call site.

t: OS3012 A required argument is missing
d: {name} requires {argument}, which has no default.

t: OS3011 Argument has the wrong type
d: {name}'s {argument} is {expected}; {found} was given.

t: OS3004 Argument is not a valid whole number
d: {name}'s {argument} must be a whole number {range}; {found} was given.

t: OS3008 The value is not valid for this parameter
d: {argument} accepts {values}; {found} is not one of them.

t: OS3010 Two arguments that cannot both be given
d: {first} and {second} set the same thing two ways.

t: OS3019 A declaration handle in an object argument
d: {name}'s {argument} is {expected}; {found} is a declaration handle, which has no value at run time.

t: OS3020 fill needs two declared plots
d: fill's {argument} is {found}; it takes a plot declared by plot() or plotCandles().

t: OS3003 This option must be a constant
d: {option} is read once, before the first bar, so it cannot depend on bar data.

t: OS3006 This call must be at the top level
d: {name} defines part of the study's fixed shape and cannot appear inside {construct}.

t: OS3007 input() must be at the top level
d: input() builds one row of the settings dialog, which is read once before the first bar.

t: OS3009 This option needs another option to be set
d: {option} = {value} requires {required}.

t: OS3016 range must be a low and a high
d: range is [{low}, {high}]; it takes two numbers and the first must be below the second.

t: OS3014 limits() is in the wrong place
d: limits() appears at most once, immediately after the declaration; this one is at line {line}.
limits() is read before the first bar, so {option} must be a literal number.

t: OS3017 Two of these share a name
d: {kind} names must be unique in a file; {name} is also used at line {line}.

t: OS3018 The default is not in the options list
d: This input's default {default} is not one of options {values}.

t: OS3021 An input written in place has no title
d: An input() assigned to no name is named by its title, and this one has no title written as a string literal.

t: OS3024 An input written in place has an empty title
d: An input() assigned to no name is named by its title, and this one's title is empty.

t: OS3022 Two inputs share a settings key
d: This input is keyed by its title {name}, which is already the name of the input at line {line}.

t: OS3023 An order names a leg this file does not declare
